This compound, in turn, is targeted by MRP7. This chain of interactions implies that fluticasone may influence the activity of MRP7 through its interaction with CMAT2 and the subsequent metabolic pathway involving 2,3-DIB. The presence of a final score of 0.7057 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of fluticasone in the regulation of MRP7. The evidence highlights a possible role of fluticasone in modulating the expression or function of MRP7 via its interaction with CMAT2 and the downstream metabolic pathway.
